answer: A plume relic: each identity holds a relic that fades a little every epoch unless it is renewed by fresh verified work, and a plume above it shows its current strength in public, so everyone can see which relics are alive and which are dead. A fake can forge a relic once, but it cannot keep it glowing without new work each epoch, and a farm cannot keep a thousand relics lit because each renewal needs its own real job and its own witness, with a thread of renewals linking each one back to the last; a thousand fakes need a thousand separately renewed relics.
